image_panes: canvas and native pyqtgraph interaction only; no standalone image toolbar

browser.refresh: icon-only standard reload tool button with Refresh tooltip and accessible name
browser.directory: separate middle-elided label with exact full-path tooltip

tools: no heading; content-sized buttons in a vertically scrollable container
section_numbers: hidden only for the vNext shell through a default-preserving panel option

navigation.single: footer catalogs all frames and selection is the current singleton
navigation.multiple: footer catalogs selected frames and changes focus without changing membership
navigation.identity: all membership and commands route by exact DisplayFrameKey identity
